correctness.rationale: Liang's exact curve, full \(C_9\)-action, undulation line, and bitangent elimination equations were checked in the primary paper. The unique order-three subgroup has an exhaustively classified fixed-line set, and direct intersection multiplicities show that only \(z=0\) is bitangent. The differential basis gives primitive ninth-root eigenvalues \(\zeta_9^{1,2,4}\), with conjugates completing all primitive ninth roots; hence the action on \(H_1\) has characteristic polynomial \(\Phi_9\), whose mod-two irreducibility proves freeness on nonzero two-torsion. Exact symbolic replay verifies the cubic-field transformations, discriminants, irreducibility, finite-field gcds, and orbit totals.

value.rationale: The claim gives the complete level-two symmetry profile of the unique order-nine plane quartic and explains the geometry arithmetically: the three free bitangent orbits are not arbitrary blocks but the three Galois-conjugate fibers of an explicit invariant whose field is \(\mathbf Q(\zeta_9+\zeta_9^{-1})\). The irreducible mod-two Jacobian action then organizes all Cayley octads and Steiner complexes. This is a natural structural invariant of the full automorphism action, not a routine parameter substitution or an isolated table recomputation.
